title: Namak Ka Masala!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

NAMAK_BHAI.look: A small, white, shimmering crystalline character with a mischievous grin and a tiny silver headband that says "Taste".

DIL_BHAI.look: A bright red, anatomically stylized heart character, with a slightly worried but kind face, wearing a tiny stethoscope around its neck.

CHEF_RAJU.look: A plump, jovial chef character with a white toque hat and a checkered apron, holding a small tasting spoon.

scenes.image: [[NAMAK_BHAI]] standing on a spice rack, winking cheekily, a spotlight on him.
scenes.speaker: NAMAK_BHAI
scenes.line: Arre main hoon Namak, tera swaad ka king, bhidu!
scenes.say: अरे मैं हूँ नमक, तेरा स्वाद का किंग, भिड़ू!

scenes.image: [[NAMAK_BHAI]] standing on a spice rack, winking cheekily, a spotlight on him.
scenes.speaker: NAMAK_BHAI
scenes.line: Mere bina har cheez ekdum pheeki, bole toh bekaar!
scenes.say: मेरे बिना हर चीज़ एकदम फीकी, बोले तो बेकार!

scenes.image: [[NAMAK_BHAI]] standing on a spice rack, winking cheekily, a spotlight on him.
scenes.speaker: NAMAK_BHAI
scenes.line: Thoda sa hi daal, aur dekh le mera kamaal!
scenes.say: थोड़ा सा ही डाल, और देख ले मेरा कमाल!

scenes.image: [[NAMAK_BHAI]] sprinkling a tiny amount of himself onto a delicious-looking plate of dal chawal, looking pleased.
scenes.speaker: NAMAK_BHAI
scenes.line: Bas ek chutki, khaane ka mood bana deti hai, sahi pakde hain!
scenes.say: बस एक चुटकी, खाने का मूड बना देती है, सही पकड़े हैं!

scenes.image: [[NAMAK_BHAI]] sprinkling a tiny amount of himself onto a delicious-looking plate of dal chawal, looking pleased.
scenes.speaker: NAMAK_BHAI
scenes.line: Zyada mat soch, thoda namak toh banta hai!
scenes.say: ज़्यादा मत सोच, थोड़ा नमक तो बनता है!

scenes.image: [[NAMAK_BHAI]] sprinkling a tiny amount of himself onto a delicious-looking plate of dal chawal, looking pleased.
scenes.speaker: NAMAK_BHAI
scenes.line: Par haan, zyada daalega toh lafda pakka hai, sun le!
scenes.say: पर हाँ, ज़्यादा डालेगा तो लफड़ा पक्का है, सुन ले!

scenes.image: [[DIL_BHAI]] looking a bit stressed, holding its chest lightly with one hand, in a plain white background with a faint "BP" symbol.
scenes.speaker: DIL_BHAI
scenes.line: Hello, main hoon tera Dil, thoda serious baat suno!
scenes.say: हेलो, मैं हूँ तेरा दिल, थोड़ा सीरियस बात सुनो!

scenes.image: [[DIL_BHAI]] looking a bit stressed, holding its chest lightly with one hand, in a plain white background with a faint "BP" symbol.
scenes.speaker: DIL_BHAI
scenes.line: Ye Namak Bhai zyada ho jaye toh mera tension badhta hai!
scenes.say: ये नमक भाई ज़्यादा हो जाए तो मेरा टेंशन बढ़ता है!

scenes.image: [[DIL_BHAI]] looking a bit stressed, holding its chest lightly with one hand, in a plain white background with a faint "BP" symbol.
scenes.speaker: DIL_BHAI
scenes.line: Zyada namak matlab high बीपी का khatra, samjha na?
scenes.say: ज़्यादा नमक मतलब हाई बीपी का खतरा, समझा ना?

scenes.image: [[DIL_BHAI]] looking concerned but firm, pointing to an animated 'BP monitor' graphic showing "HIGH" in the background.
scenes.speaker: DIL_BHAI
scenes.line: Isliye, namak ko limit mein rakh, healthy rehna hai toh!
scenes.say: इसलिए, नमक को लिमिट में रख, हेल्दी रहना है तो!

scenes.image: [[DIL_BHAI]] looking concerned but firm, pointing to an animated 'BP monitor' graphic showing "HIGH" in the background.
scenes.speaker: DIL_BHAI
scenes.line: Agar kuch gadbad lage toh, seedha डॉक्टर ko dikha, tension nahi lene ka.
scenes.say: अगर कुछ गड़बड़ लगे तो, सीधा डॉक्टर को दिखा, टेंशन नहीं लेने का।

scenes.image: [[DIL_BHAI]] looking concerned but firm, pointing to an animated 'BP monitor' graphic showing "HIGH" in the background.
scenes.speaker: DIL_BHAI
scenes.line: Apne Dil ka khayal rakh, bade kaam ki cheez hai, bhidu!
scenes.say: अपने दिल का ख्याल रख, बड़े काम की चीज़ है, भिड़ू!

scenes.image: [[CHEF_RAJU]] in a clean, brightly lit kitchen, holding up a small pinch of salt in his fingers, smiling knowingly.
scenes.speaker: CHEF_RAJU
scenes.line: Namaste bhaiyon, main hoon Chef Raju, suno meri tip!
scenes.say: नमस्ते भाइयों, मैं हूँ शेफ राजू, सुनो मेरी टिप!

scenes.image: [[CHEF_RAJU]] in a clean, brightly lit kitchen, holding up a small pinch of salt in his fingers, smiling knowingly.
scenes.speaker: CHEF_RAJU
scenes.line: Khana banate waqt jitna namak chahiye, bas utna hi!
scenes.say: खाना बनाते वक़्त जितना नमक चाहिए, बस उतना ही!

scenes.image: [[CHEF_RAJU]] in a clean, brightly lit kitchen, holding up a small pinch of salt in his fingers, smiling knowingly.
scenes.speaker: CHEF_RAJU
scenes.line: Table pe extra namak ka dabba rakhne ki koi zaroorat nahi.
scenes.say: टेबल पे एक्स्ट्रा नमक का डब्बा रखने की कोई ज़रूरत नहीं।

scenes.image: [[CHEF_RAJU]] making a thoughtful gesture, perhaps wiping his hands on his apron, looking directly at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: CHEF_RAJU
scenes.line: Saada khana, kam namak, yeh hai sehat ka nuskha.
scenes.say: सादा खाना, कम नमक, यह है सेहत का नुस्खा।

scenes.image: [[CHEF_RAJU]] making a thoughtful gesture, perhaps wiping his hands on his apron, looking directly at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: CHEF_RAJU
scenes.line: Taste ko naturally badhao, masala aur herbs se.
scenes.say: टेस्ट को नेचुरली बढ़ाओ, मसाला और हर्ब्स से।

scenes.image: [[CHEF_RAJU]] making a thoughtful gesture, perhaps wiping his hands on his apron, looking directly at the viewer.
scenes.speaker: CHEF_RAJU
scenes.line: Aap din mein kitna namak extra daalte ho, comment mein batao?
scenes.say: आप दिन में कितना नमक एक्स्ट्रा डालते हो, कमेंट में बताओ?
